subdivide_mesh: subdivide a trimesh mesh so all edges are shorter than a given max edge length threshold
create_RendererHtt: create a RendererHtt instance with a specified width, height, shading mode, and background color
add_object_RendererHtt: add a 3D object model to the RendererHtt renderer by loading and subdividing a mesh file
remove_object_RendererHtt: remove a previously added object model from the RendererHtt renderer by its object ID
render_object_RendererHtt: render a 3D object with rotation, translation, and camera parameters to produce RGB, mask, and depth images
